what: New Reflection section, every trigger deterministic: the supervisor's octo-feather-lane archive runs a fresh headless lane reflection and then a director reflection before moving any file (refusing, files in place, when one cannot run), and a lane or director start runs the director reflection when the last is over a day old; the reflector answers the kit's question list (data, one owner), counts finding classes across all lanes and routes each repeated class to the writer (role, skill, template, structure); a gap an earlier reflection missed is a reflection-missed finding. Findings go as source-reflection finding lines (question, route) into the lane's hand-off log or the director log, plus one reflection line per run; after each reflection the reflect command applies the correction-lane rule and files each due correction lane's parent issue; the report shows the director reflection's last run.
why: Owner rulings on issue #230 (2026-10-27, 2026-10-28): the factory introspects itself without the owner as the loop: a fresh cross-family reflector (openai/gpt-6.1-sol, high) reflects at every lane close and on the director's work after each merge relay and at least daily, mines review finding classes across lanes and routes each recurring writer mistake to prevention at the writer, and a gap a reflection missed updates its question list (questions owned once, as data). Reuses pstack reflect (vendored, Pi/Herdr patch). Goes to owner review and Accept before any lane code.
evidence: No spec covers reflection: grep -ci reflect docs/specs/*.spec.html at main 2e1f97d prints 0 for every spec; issue #230 owner comment 2026-10-28: 'Today the repeat trigger counts classes but nothing asks why writers keep making them; seven review rounds on #188 were mostly restated rules'; jq over lanes/{,archive/}*.handoffs.jsonl 2026-10-28 counts code-review duplicated-rule 35, missing-behavior-smoke 9, proxy-check 5, implementation-coupled-test 5, large-module 5 with no writer-side routing.

what: A correction lane is filed in the tracker of the repository that owns its route's artifact: the kit's for kit roles, skills, evals, scripts, templates or the question list, for a class no reflection routed (untagged legacy routes included) and for every reflection-missed finding; a target's only for a route a lane reflection of that target marks `target:`, quoting only that target's lanes' findings; never a repository whose lane only contributed a finding. A finding from a lane of another repository than the tracker's is quoted, in issues and recurrence comments alike, by lane, date and class only, never its summary, route or evidence (kit public, targets may be private). A `target:` route whose lane record names no repository, or a repository renamed or re-created after the lane started, refuses naming the record to fix. Adds acceptance-reflect-files-route-owner. Extends the existing filing step (octo-feather-lane file_corrections) and the reflector's route field; no second mechanism.
